name: IBM watsonx.ai
tagline: Enterprise foundation-model inference with IBM governance tooling.
description: IBM watsonx.ai is an AI development studio and runtime for building, tuning, evaluating, deploying, and running foundation-model and machine-learning applications. Governance capabilities are provided by the separately provisioned watsonx.governance service within the broader watsonx platform.

auth.details: IBM Cloud IAM bearer token via Authorization: Bearer header. Obtain token using API key with IAM token endpoint (https://iam.cloud.ibm.com/identity/token).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Toolbox: up to 300,000 foundation-model tokens, 20 compute usage hours, and 100 text-extraction documents per month.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go based on tokens processed; enterprise plans available. Pricing varies by model and region.

rate_limits: At least 2 inference requests/second for Lite and 8 requests/second for Essentials and Standard; actual limits can be higher.

example.request: curl -X POST "https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/text/chat?version=2025-10-25" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_IAM_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" -d '{"model_id":"openai/gpt-oss-120b","project_id":"YOUR_PROJECT_ID","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}],"max_completion_tokens":100}'

use_cases: generate text completions with enterprise foundation models
run chat-style inference against IBM Granite or third-party models
score or classify text with hosted models under IBM governance
embed documents for RAG pipelines in regulated environments
deploy and call fine-tuned models with project-scoped access control
